content:
Anya Patel: Morning — quick async check-in for launch week. Posted the benchmark post draft in Google Drive, need an edit pass and final numbers.
Sam Rivera: On it, will read after standup. Are the graphs final or placeholders?
Anya Patel: Placeholders for now; Miguel added run results but we need latency/price callouts.
Miguel Torres: I can export the latest CSV after the noon run. Expect cleaned numbers by 12:30.
Devin (growth): Also want to confirm CTA copy variations. I suggested 3 options in the doc comments.
Anya Patel: Yep saw them — prefer option B for landing, A for the tweet. Can someone sanity-check A/B impact?
Sam Rivera: I can mock a quick GA event plan for both. Will paste the snippet here.
Sam Rivera: ```events:
  - name: benchmark_click_A
  - name: benchmark_click_B```
Lia - Ops: Heads up — legal asked for a short data blurb about model provenance. Do we have wording?
Miguel Torres: Suggest: "Benchmarks run on Redwood-hosted open models with consistent tokenization; see appendix for methodology." Want me to add small methodology section.
Anya Patel: That wording works. Please add 2-3 bullet method steps under the appendix.
Miguel Torres: Will do, adding latency percentiles + VM types.
Devin (growth): Timeline check — blog scheduled for Thursday 9am PT. Creative needs final assets by Wednesday EOD.
Anya Patel: Creative assigned to @Sam for hero, @Lia for screenshots. Can you confirm?
Sam Rivera: Confirmed for hero. I’ll need the final chart PNGs from Miguel by 3pm tomorrow.
Lia - Ops: I can capture screenshots today after Miguel uploads charts. Also will run a quick accessibility check on the hero.
marketing-bot: Reminder: content-calendar slot reserved (Thu 09:00 PT) — auto-post enabled.
Anya Patel: Blockers?
Miguel Torres: Minor: one noisy run produced an outlier in p99 on the 32k token test. Investigating whether it’s infra noise. If not fixed, will note in footnote.
Devin (growth): Noted. If p99 varies, we should surface median + IQR instead of only mean. Less chance of misleading headline.
Anya Patel: Agreed. Change headline to focus on median latency and cost per 1k tokens.
Sam Rivera: Quick ask — can someone review the pull request for the blog template? It's pending with 2 small comments.
Anya Patel: I’ll review after Miguel's numbers.
Lia - Ops: FYI — staging deploy for the blog preview is at https://staging.redwood.ai/benchmarks (password in 1Password).
Miguel Torres: Uploaded CSV + PNGs to Drive and pushed to the branch. Pulled the failing run; filing an infra note.
Anya Patel: Perfect — thanks team. If no urgent blockers, I'll consolidate edits and send final draft for sign-off by 5pm PT. :thumbsup:
Devin (growth): Sounds good. I’ll queue the 2 subject line variations for testing.
Sam Rivera: Will finish hero and PR comments tonight.
Lia - Ops: Accessibility pass done tomorrow AM.
Anya Patel: Great. If anyone hits a blocker, ping here or DM. Otherwise we’ll reconvene in the thread for final sign-off. :sparkles:
